item.title: Rocker the coonhound nabs Best in Show at 2026 National Dog Show
item.description: The black and tan coonhound defeated six other outstanding dogs to claim the 2026 National Dog Show's top honor.

item.title: Trump to visit Arizona manufacturer of semiconductor chips
item.description: President Trump will visit the Phoenix TSMC facility, one of the largest manufacturers of advanced chips, including Nvidia's.

item.title: Iran accused of carrying out drone attack killing 2 Italians in Kuwait
item.description: Iran denies being behind a deadly attack on a Kuwaiti military facility that killed two Italian nationals.

item.title: Trump claims "fake economic numbers" were released before election
item.description: President Trump demanded an investigation into the Commerce Department's recent revising of the GDP, which happens routinely.

item.title: Fake online stores may fool AI shopping bots on Black Friday
item.description: AI bots are accidentally steering shoppers toward websites and online shops created by scammers using AI.

item.title: Germany arrests 2 Iraqis allegedly tied to Iran-linked terror group
item.description: German police arrested two Iraqi men alleged to be members of an Iran-linked terrorist organization​ that is said to have targeted U.S., Israeli and Jewish institutions in Europe.

item.title: Maps show where Thanksgiving storms are disrupting holiday plans
item.description: Rain, snow and powerful winds were affecting large stretches of the country on Thanksgiving, potentially disrupting holiday festivities and, in some areas, hampering travel plans.

item.title: FedEx cargo plane runs off MIA runway, causing brief ground stop
item.description: The National Transportation Safety Board said it was investigating the incident.

item.title: Elon Musk doubles SpaceX share pledge for U.S. children
item.description: Every child in the U.S. will receive one share of SpaceX from the company and one from Elon Musk.

item.title: High school band raises $350K to stay for Macy's Thanksgiving parade
item.description: Other marching bands from around the U.S. are also raising funds to cover the cost of staying in New York City after the parade was rescheduled for Saturday.

item.title: Food banks see influx of families ahead of Thanksgiving
item.description: Across the U.S., volunteers have noticed more families than usual seeking food assistance as people struggle with higher grocery costs.

item.title: ICE detains man after he picked up $1 million lottery winnings
item.description: The Massachusetts State Lottery posted on social media last week a photo of Ariel Velasquez-Morales, who won $1 million from a scratch-off ticket purchased in Boston.

item.title: Could the Black Sea pull the U.S. into war in Europe?
item.description: The Russia-Ukraine war is spilling into the Black Sea, where violent incidents have surged, running right up to NATO's doorstep.

item.title: Where to get the latest CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: It's Day 2 of CBS Mornings Deals' special series, 12 Days of Gifting, where we show viewers even more products at even lower prices. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: French actor Gérard Depardieu to stand trial on rape charge
item.description: A lawyer representing French actor Gérard Depardieu says he has been ordered to stand trial on a charge of raping a young actress at his Paris home in 2018.

item.title: Food banks overwhelmed as people struggle to afford Thanksgiving meals
item.description: Food banks and resource centers are overwhelmed this season, with nearly 6.5 million fewer Americans receiving food assistance this year. Jason Allen reports.

item.title: These are the best holiday rom-coms to watch, according to an expert
item.description: Fandango and Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Erik Davis joins "CBS Mornings" to share some of his favorite holiday romantic comedies, new and old, to watch this year.

item.title: FedEx plane slides off Miami runway while landing during stormy weather, causes ground stop
item.description: A FedEx cargo plane slid off the runway at Miami International Airport on Wednesday. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: Shopping strategies to make the most of Black Friday deals
item.description: Trae Bodge, a lifestyle writer and smart shopping expert, joins "CBS Mornings" to share ways you can make the most of Black Friday deals.

item.title: Macy's parade postponed as inclement weather slams U.S.
item.description: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed until Saturday due to severe weather conditions Thursday. Meanwhile, it's snowing in the Midwest and there are flood warnings on both coasts. Rob Marciano reports.

item.title: The story behind this Eagles player's special Thanksgiving cleats
item.description: For Philadelphia Eagles cornerback Jonathan Jones, the team's slogan has a personal meaning that extends beyond the football field.

item.title: Here's why the Black Sea matters for NATO in the Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: Chris Livesay traveled to Romania to learn about the Black Sea's role in the Russia-Ukraine war, as its Navy works to fend off rogue attacks from Russia targeting Ukraine.

item.title: No lead detected in Iowa air after Army's detonation, EPA says
item.description: No lead has been detected in the air near the Army's controlled blast site in Iowa, where they detonated nearly five tons of lead explosives on Wednesday, according to the Environmental Protection Agency. Some locals remain concerned. Ian Lee reports.

item.title: What's open and closed today on Thanksgiving Day 2026?
item.description: A handful of grocery stores will welcome customers on Thanksgiving this year, while most retailers will be closed. Here's what to know.

item.title: Judge temporarily blocks FCC from reviewing ABC's licenses
item.description: A federal judge blocked the FCC from moving forward with an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses, a move the network argues is an attempt by the Trump administration to punish speech it does not like.

item.title: Judge declines to issue long-term ban on tax-funded pro-Trump ads
item.description: A federal judge has sided against Democrats on the federal government's taxpayer-funded political ads, which critics say were illegal propaganda intended to promote President Trump.

item.title: Andy Taylor, longtime Duran Duran guitarist, dies at 65
item.description: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died at age 65 following a battle with prostate cancer.

item.title: U.S.-based firms helping China access Nvidia's most advanced chips
item.description: It's not just Megaspeed. A CBS News investigation reveals that at least two California-based Nvidia customers have Chinese ownership — giving the U.S. adversary potential access to Nvidia's most advanced technology.

item.title: How a new generation of AI agents could change holiday shopping
item.description: The internet revolutionized holiday shopping by allowing people to make purchases without leaving their homes. Now, a new generation of AI agents is promising an even bigger change: Doing the shopping for you. Jared Ochacher reports on what to look out for if you're planning to hand over your holiday list to an AI agent this year.

item.title: Trump administration to issue new tariffs on China, EU and others
item.description: The U.S. will increase tariffs on Chinese goods by an additional 20% and raise import taxes on goods from other major economies.
